title: feat(plugin-form,types,app-shell)!: object-form.layout is vertical | horizontal on every face — delivers objectui#7759 group C (objectui#11168 slice 3)
body:
Refs #11168
Refs #7759

Clause-②: no (narrowing). Nothing widens. `object-form.layout` loses `inline` / `grid` on the registration, on both `ObjectFormSchema` faces and in the designer, and the `form` node's zod `FormSchema.layout` loses `grid`. The fixed group ships it as `minor`. (The claim's line reads `yes` for slice 3 as a whole; that answer lives on the lazy-blocks PR, objectui#11335, `yes (narrowing)`. This PR widens nothing, so it carries the `no (narrowing)` arm.)

This PR delivers objectui#7759 group C, as objectui#11168 slice 3 part 2 of 2. It was split from objectui#11335 at the PM seat's boundary. The direction was settled before dispatch (triage `5863068721`): narrow objectui's `layout` mirror to `vertical | horizontal`, following the spec, with no alias and no fold. `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 retired `inline` / `grid` (objectstack#20221), and the installed row refuses both with `invalid_value` at `layout`.

## Measured at this base (`5262f7dd3`), before any edit

The probe ran through the real `SchemaRenderer`, normalised `body.innerHTML` (ids, React ids, Radix ids, `data-state`), on an `object-form` with `mode: 'create'`:

| formType | `grid` == `vertical` | `inline` == `vertical` | absent == `vertical` | `horizontal` == `vertical` (lit control) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| simple | yes | yes | yes | no |
| tabbed | yes | yes | yes | no |
| wizard | yes | yes | yes | no |
| split | yes | yes | yes | no |

- The `form` renderer draws `grid` exactly as it draws `vertical` (`justify-start`, the same markup length). `horizontal` gives `justify-end`. The renderer reads only `layout === 'horizontal'`.
- ⚠️ `drawer` / `modal`: NOT MEASURED in this harness. The lit control did not fire there (even `horizontal` matched `vertical`, because the overlay body is not mounted by that probe), so those two rows prove nothing. The earlier record `5855353651` covers them; I did not re-derive it here.
- The authoring doors:
  - `objectui validate` already refused `properties.layout` `inline` / `grid` on an authored `object-form`, with `invalid_value` at `properties.layout`. The bag arm reads the spec row by reference, and `horizontal` was the lit control. **The acceptance row held at the base.**
  - The `ObjectFormSchema` mirror accepted all four values.
  - `FormSchema` accepted `grid`.
- **Producers**: zero authored outside the designer. The repo-wide grep finds `layout: 'inline' / 'grid'` only on other schemas (detail-view, filter-ui, AI, record highlights). The designer's `object-form` inspector OFFERED both values.

## What narrows (the objectui#7759 group C surface, item by item)

1. **`ObjectFormSchema.layout`, both faces.** It is the row's own enum by reference: `SpecObjectFormProps['layout']` on the TS face and `stripImportedDefaults(SpecObjectFormPropsSchema).shape.layout` on the zod face. `ObjectViewSchema.form` picks the key, so it narrows with it. `columns` loses its "for grid layout" wording: it sets the field grid's width, whatever the `layout`.
2. **The zod `FormSchema` mirror** drops `grid`. Its `WiderThanDeclared` row (`form.zod.ts#FormSchema::layout`, CONCRETE) resolves and is struck, together with its `WIDER_ARMS` row. The header figures, re-derived: 4 / 4 / 4 — 2 / 2 / 0 / 0 became **3 / 3 / 3 — 2 / 1 / 0 / 0**, with a dated history line. `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` reconciles the figures (green) and tsc compiles the ledger (green).
3. **The `object-form` registration `inputs`**: `layout` is `['vertical', 'horizontal']`, now with a description.
4. **The designer**: `block-config.ts` no longer offers `inline` / `grid`. Their two labels (en, zh) are removed, and `check:i18n-designer-parity` stays green.
5. **The fold sites**: the retired values had no branches of their own; the folds mapped them to `vertical`. The folds are retired, mechanically and only in `plugin-form`, at five sites: `ObjectForm` (simple, drawer, modal), `DrawerForm` and `ModalForm`. `layout` now passes through, and an absent `layout` still draws as `vertical` (pinned).
6. **Docs**: `plugin-view.mdx` listed the four values for `form.layout` and now lists two. `schema-reference.md` already said they were retired, and the `plugin-form` README already said `vertical | horizontal`.

## Ledger (registry parity guard)

`OFF_SPEC_ARM_EXEMPTIONS` is EMPTY again: `object-form.layout:enum` is struck and `refusedArms` goes 1 → 0. The owner count for `objectui#11168` goes 8 → 7 on this base.

⚠️ objectui#11335 moves the same owner-count line (8 → 6 there) and the same caps object. Whichever PR lands second merges `main` and re-derives that line and the cap comment.

## Pin

`packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/objectFormLayout-11168.test.tsx` holds 10 rows plus compile-time rows checked by `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`:
- the registration enum;
- the acceptance rows (`objectui validate` refuses `inline` and `grid`, with the two live values as the lit control);
- both mirrors refusing at `layout`;
- `FormSchema` against the `form` registration;
- the TS face equal to the spec row's type, with `@ts-expect-error` on both retired values;
- an absent `layout` rendering byte-identical to `vertical`, with `horizontal` as the lit control.

## Ablations (predictions written first; every leg restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty)

| F | the zod `ObjectFormSchema.layout` back to the four values | 2 mirror rows red; tsc red at the `WiderThanDeclared` reconciliation | exactly those 2 (8 green); tsc exit 2, `WiderLedgerMismatch` and `WiderLedgerKeyDrift` in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` |
